description_en: Enables or disables the memory feature for the specified agent instances
description_zh: 批量启用或关闭指定 Agent 实例的记忆功能
name: ModifyAgentInstanceMemoryConfig

parameters.help_en: The list of agent instance IDs. You can specify 1 to 100 IDs, and the IDs must be unique. Each instance must belong to the current account, support memory management, and have the memory feature configured
parameters.help_zh: Agent 实例 ID 列表，至少 1 个、最多 100 个，ID 不得重复。每个实例均须属于当前账号、支持记忆管理且已配置记忆功能
parameters.name: agent_instance_ids

parameters.help_en:
Required. Specifies whether to enable the memory feature. Valid values:
true: Enables the memory feature.
false: Disables the memory feature.
Before you enable the feature, ensure that the tenant-level memory store is enabled
parameters.help_zh: 服务端要求提供。`true` 表示启用记忆，`false` 表示关闭记忆。启用前须确保租户级记忆库开关已打开
parameters.name: enabled

schema.description_en: The response to the API call
schema.description_zh: 本次 API 调用的响应结果

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, which can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于排查问题
